useCase: Detección de alteración de imágenes through re-saving, quality manipulación, and spliced regions with different compression histories
mechanism: Analiza DCT coeficiente histogramas for periodic patrones caused by double quantization. When a JPEG image is decompressed and re-compressed at a different quality, the DCT coeficientes exhibit characteristic periodic artefactos (combing effect) in their histogramas that are detectable through frequency análisis.
accuracy: Alta - 82-92% for images with detectable double compression
name: Detección de Doble Compresión JPEG
source: Lukáš & Fridrich (2003) - Estimation of Primary Quantization Matrix in Double-Compressed JPEG Images, DFRWS
parameters: Tamaño de bloque: 8x8 DCT, Quality range: 50-99, Analysis: histograma periodicity via DFT, Detection umbral: adaptativo
description: Detecta traces of double compresión JPEG mediante el análisis de DCT coeficiente histogramas. Tampering often involves re-saving, creating detectable periodic patrones in DCT domain.

references.title: Lukáš, J. & Fridrich, J. (2003). Estimation of Primary Quantization Matrix in Double-Compressed JPEG Images. DFRWS.
Bianchi, T. & Piva, A. (2012). Image Forgery Localization via Block-Grained Analysis of JPEG Artifacts. IEEE TIFS.
Lukas, J., & Fridrich, J. (2003). Estimation of primary quantization matrix in double compressed JPEG images. DFRWS.

strengths:
• Muy fiable para detectar JPEGs re-guardados
• Puede estimar la calidad de compresión original
• Localiza regiones manipuladas
• Base matemática bien establecida
limitations:
• Only works on JPEG format images
• Ineffective when both compressions use same quality
• Cannot detect single-compressed AI images
• Requires sufficient image size for estadístico fiabilidad
